Dialogs.Dialog: Phew, I'm done with my work today...
Ah, a message...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ texted me. She should've already left. Did she forget something？
"Please come behind the school building. Nene"
(Calling me out by text...)
(But why at school...？)
(Behind the school building...)
▲Anegasaki＊▲！
Anegasaki
What's going on, all of a sudden？ And why at school, of all places...
Well, I was thinking that Dixie's might be okay, but...
If... just if. If I were in the same year as you...
I wondered if we might have met at school.
If we might have spent most of our time together at school.
Thinking about that, I ended up coming here...
Hey, do you remember the first time we met？
Yeah, I came in through the front of the restaurant by mistake...
I thought, "This kid's already messing up, will he be okay？" Just a tiny bit.
Hehe, maybe it was the spring warmth？
It was hot. And ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, who looked really hot too, was carrying stuff and working hard.
Hehe, I was grumbling a bit, wasn't I？ It was embarrassing that you heard, you know？
I guess the heat and the work had worn me down a little...
It was a cool fall day. I showed up for my first day at work and was surprised to find a beautiful girl there.
Right, you flattered me right off the bat. I was so surprised.
It wasn't flattery, though. Like I said back then.
Back then I mistook you for a smooth talker.
It was a freezing day, and you were cleaning in front of the restaurant, right？
Yeah, that was rough...
Actually, another staff member was absent on that day. That's why I had to sweep out there.
Back then, I was thinking...
What？
A new kid was starting, I'd be training him, and he was a junior from my school, too...
I figured he'd end up relying on me, like always.
Did you not like that？
No, it's not that. I just figured that's how it would go. Because it always had...
But it wasn't like that. You betrayed my expectations.
Betrayed？
Yes, you're unreliable in places, and you do seem younger, but that's not all.
"If it's hard, lean on me"... You're the kind of boy who'd even say something like that.
I told you once, didn't I？ The real me isn't that together a person.
Yes...
...There was someone I liked.
Someone older... I kept stretching myself as far as I could, trying to be worthy of him...
And the result was the reliable Nene-san everyone knows.
But that's not me. I just want the person I love to like me.
I want the person I love to be by my side...
I want... you to keep me by your side...
I... love you...
I love you, too
Sorry
...Really？
Yeah, I want ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ by my side too.
I want you to be my girlfriend.
I'm so happy...
Me, too...
Can I come closer？
I've always wanted to do this...
Can I kiss you...？
Ah...
▲Anegasaki＊▲？
Never mind... okay...
Sorry, okay？ For a kiss like this...
I'll apologize again later...
I can't think of you that way...
I like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, but...
It's in a different way... so...
No, it's okay... thank you for hearing me out.
Sorry...
Don't apologize. I'm the one who brought it up.
But, what do I do... from now on.
If I can, let me keep loving you like this...
Yeah, I'll keep liking ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ as a friend too...
Thank you, but it's okay. As long as you let me love you, even if we're not friends...
I love you...
Phew, done with work for today...
A call... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ She should've already left...
Hello...
Anegasaki
Hello. Um...
(Calling me out by phone, of all things...)
(Still... why school...？)
(It was behind the school building...)
▲Anegasaki＊▲！
▲主人公＊▲.
What's up, calling me out by phone？
And all the way to school...
Because... Dixie's has lots of memories of you, but what I want isn't the memories we already have.
Hey, do you remember the first time we met？
I... came in through the front entrance instead of the staff one...
Hehe, right. I thought, this one's going to be a project to train. Maybe the spring warmth had you spacing out？
In the heat, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was working hard, dripping with sweat...
Geez, you should've forgotten about that embarrassing moment.
It wasn't embarrassing... I just thought you were working so hard.
Really？ Then that's fine.
It was a cool fall day... and I met a beauty at my new job.
Geez, if you keep saying things like that to girls you just met, you'll grow up into a bad adult, you know？
"Keep"... that just slipped out on the spot...
Hehe, just kidding.
It was really cold. Cleaning outside looked tough.
Yeah, it was so painful. My hands became all numb.
But that was me covering for a staff member who was off...
Back then, I was a teeny bit gloomy.
Eh？ Why？
Because it was another new kid to train, and on top of that, a junior from my school...
Sorry...
Hehe, you don't need to apologize. I was being mean.
But it turned out to be fun, so it's fine...
Interesting？
Right. A newbie, younger than me, and yet this cheeky boy tells me I can lean on him.
It was so funny... and it made me happy that you said that.
I see...
I told you once, didn't I？ That the real me isn't really that together.
Yes...
You know, there was someone I liked.
Someone older.
I worked hard, pushed myself, trying to stand by his side.
That's all it was.
Looking back, part of me wondered if that version of me was right...
But seeing you now, I feel like the me back then wasn't wrong.
Because you, working so hard, are pure, cute, attractive...
I've fallen for you...
Won't you... be my boyfriend...？
I love you too
Sorry
Huh, you will...？
Yeah... if you'll have me, I want to be ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s boyfriend.
...I'm your girlfriend, okay？ Not your big sister？
Yes, I know...
I see. Then from now on, you are my boyfriend.
...Hey, I'm coming over there？
O-Okay...
Hehe, isn't your heart pounding？
Of course it is...
Don't you want to kiss？
That's...
I do...
...What's wrong？
W-well...
Hey, hush？
You're the one asking what's wrong...
Hush...
I don't... see you that way...
I like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, but probably not the same way ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ likes me...
So...
No, it's okay.
It's a shame, but it can't be helped...
Geez, stop apologizing. That's one of the things I fell for, though...
Hey, don't avoid me from now on, okay？
Yeah, of course.
Then that's fine...
Let's keep getting along, okay？
Phew, almost done. Just a little more push！
Anegasaki
Hey.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... oh right, you got off early today.
Um...
(She wants to talk after work... what could it be...)
(And at school？ Why...)
(Behind the school building, right...)
▲Anegasaki＊▲！
▲主人公＊▲.
What's up？ You said you wanted to talk.
And not at Dixie's, but at school...
Because at Dixie's we might get interrupted, right？
I want to talk, just the two of us.
No... it's something I can only say when we're alone...
Which is...？
Geez, don't rush me...
While I was waiting for you, I thought about the first time we met.
Hey, do you remember？
I came to work, and just walked in the front door like normal, didn't I...
Hehe, anyone would think you were a customer.
It was a warm, sunny day, so maybe that was why？ Hehe.
It was such a hot day, but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was working very hard.
Back then... honestly, I was worn out...
It was hot and heavy... it was a little embarrassing to be seen like that.
It was a cool fall day... and I was surprised the girl who helped me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, was so beautiful...
You don't have to recreate the flattery too.
That was just my honest reaction slipping out...
Geez, that's embarrassing.
You were cleaning outside the restaurant, on such a cold day.
That was rough... I was thinking, why today of all days！
It was extra rough since I was covering for someone who was off.
At that time, I didn't think that things would turn out this way...
Like this？
Training a junior from school, I figured he'd end up relying on me again.
...Sorry it turned out exactly like that.
Hehe, it's fine. That part went just as I expected.
Working so hard at a job you weren't used to, and still telling your senior she could lean on you. It was so cute.
Normally I want new people to become full-fledged quickly, but with you it was different.
I wanted to keep looking after you forever. I didn't want to let you go.
I told you before, right？ The real me isn't that together.
Yes...
Well, I had someone that I loved...
Someone older.
I didn't want to just be supported by him, so I worked hard to grow up too.
That's how I became who I am now, but to him, I guess I was still just a cute younger girl.
But, you know, that doesn't matter anymore.
Right now, I just can't help how cute you are.
So cute, I don't want to let you go... in other words... I love you.
I... want you to be my boyfriend.
I love you, too
Sorry...
Eh？ That's...
Yeah... because I love ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ too.
Really？ I don't want to be treated like a big sister, okay？
Yeah, not like that. I love you as a woman.
That makes me happy... Can I come over there？
Hehe...
What？
Hey, I'll give you a kiss...
Huh, really...？
Yes, I'm doing it because I want to.
...What is it？
What do you mean, what...
Hehe, you want more？
No... well, not no...
Good, honest boy...
I didn't see ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ that way...
I like you, but it's a different kind of like...
So...
Haah, I thought so...
Are older girls no good after all？ Do you like girls your own age？ Or younger？
Age has nothing to do with it...
But you think of me like a big sister？
...Yeah, maybe...
I see. Then that's fine, I guess...
Let me keep being your big sister from now on...？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲.
If you don't like it, you can say no... but from now on, can I call you by your first name？
Sure, that's fine
Keep it like before
T-Thanks.
▲主人公＊▲. Um... I'm in your care.
Ah, okay, right... got it.
You're not answering, so is that okay？ I'm going to call you that, then？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲.
Hey, I'm going to call you by your first name from now on, okay？
Sure, that's fine
Keep it like before
Hehe, right.
▲主人公＊▲. Let's get along from now on, okay？
Huh, really...？ Then I guess we can keep it like this for a while.
Going quiet on me, are you embarrassed？ Hehe, I'm going to call you that, then.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲.
I'd be happy if I could call you by your first name from now on. How about it？
Sure, that's fine
Keep it like before
Hehe. Yay！
▲主人公＊▲. Let's get along, okay？
Shame... but okay. We'll keep it like this for a while.
Huh, what's wrong？ ...I'm going to call you by your first name, okay？
Anegasaki
Only if it's not a bother, but... would you go on a date with me this Sunday？
Okay, sounds good
I'll ask you next time
Really？ I'm so happy. It's a promise, okay？
I see... Too bad, but it can't be helped, huh？
I knew it... it's a bother, asking out of nowhere.
Ah, no. I just spaced out. A date, sure, that's fine.
Really？ I'm so glad...
Anegasaki
Hey, since this is a special occasion, go on a date with me this Sunday？
Okay, sounds good
I'll ask you next time
Hehe, nice reply. It's a promise, okay？
Hmm, I see. ...Fine, next time then.
Hey？ Were you listening？
Ah, no. I just spaced out. A date, sure, that's fine.
Geez, I thought you were turning me down. Hehe.
Anegasaki
I was hoping I could go on a date with you this Sunday...
Okay, sounds good
I'll ask you next time
Hehe, thanks.
Huh, okay... Yes, I understand. Next time, then？
...Is it bad timing？
Sorry, I spaced out a bit. A date, got it.
Yay, I'm so happy. Then, it's a date？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. From now on, um... let's get along.
Yeah, same here.
Bye-bye... see you.
Bye-bye. See you.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Looking forward to what's ahead.
Yeah, same here.
Okay, bye-bye！
Bye-bye. I'll see you later.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Let's keep getting along, okay？
Yeah, same here.
Bye-bye！ I'll see you later.
Bye-bye. See you later.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲.
Thank you for keeping me by your side...
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲.
We're together from now on, so be ready, okay？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲.
From now on, we'll be together... forever, okay？
